The experiments support a bounded role for witness repair as a review mechanism. They do not support replacing PCA for broad observation detection or direct relation residuals for association detection. A measured benefit appears at a small review budget in one nonlinear synthetic configuration and reverses as coverage expands. The selected score there is gain alone. The edit and model-spread penalties should therefore remain inspectable options whose use requires evidence, rather than mandatory markers of confidence.
